GLP-3 · 20 mg

Referencia para investigación metabólica in vitro.

COA por loteRUO
Metabolic pathways

GLP-3R

GLP-3R is a 39 amino acid synthetic peptide engineered to activate three receptors involved in metabolism: GIP, GLP-1, and glucagon receptors. Researchers use this triple-receptor profile to explore coordinated pathway activity in models of energy balance, nutrient processing, substrate use, and liver fat content.

Research context · Not a therapeutic claim

Dual-pathway research

GLP-2

This reference is positioned for comparative in vitro work on coordinated incretin signalling. Research models commonly examine how paired pathways influence nutrient sensing, glucose handling, cellular energy allocation, and downstream metabolic markers relative to single-pathway controls.

Research context · 30 mg reference

Matrix signalling

GHK-Cu

GHK-Cu is a copper-binding tripeptide used in laboratory models that examine extracellular-matrix signalling, collagen-associated pathways, oxidative stress, and cell migration. Its metal-binding behaviour also makes identity, copper content, and analytical method important parts of the lot record.

Research context · 50 mg reference

Mitochondrial communication

MOTS-C

MOTS-C is a mitochondrial-derived peptide studied as a signalling link between mitochondrial status and whole-cell metabolism. Laboratory work often explores metabolic stress responses, AMPK-related pathways, glucose utilisation, mitochondrial communication, and adaptive changes under controlled conditions.

Receptor selectivity

Ipamorelin

Ipamorelin is commonly examined as a selective ghrelin-receptor agonist in receptor-binding and signalling models. Researchers use it to compare pathway selectivity, dose-response behaviour in vitro, and downstream secretory signalling against broader-activity reference compounds.

GHRH signalling

Tesamorelin

Tesamorelin is a synthetic analogue used in laboratory studies of growth-hormone-releasing-hormone receptor signalling. Research settings may examine receptor activation, secretory-axis models, lipid-related biomarkers, and comparative stability while maintaining appropriate controls.

Multi-peptide matrix

GLOW

GLOW is presented as a multi-peptide research blend for exploratory work on repair-associated signalling, matrix remodelling, and coordinated cellular responses. Neuroendocrine signalling

Kisspeptin

Kisspeptin is an endogenous ligand for the KISS1R receptor, historically known as GPR54. Researchers use it in receptor and neuroendocrine models to examine KISS1R activation, GnRH-axis signalling, feedback networks, and species- or fragment-dependent responses under controlled conditions.

VIP

Quality system — COA

Proof before promise.

La pureza no debe ser una frase de marketing. Cada afirmación de ≥99% queda vinculada al certificado analítico del lote correspondiente.

Consulta documental por lote

Prueba la interfaz con NVM-G3-0529. Los códigos de esta propuesta son demostrativos y deberán sustituirse por lotes y COA reales.

Ingresa el lote impreso en la etiqueta.
01

Identidad

El nombre, la concentración y el número de lote de la etiqueta deben coincidir exactamente con el certificado.

02

Pureza

El resultado reportado por el laboratorio independiente respalda —o corrige— la especificación objetivo de ≥99%.

03

Trazabilidad

Fecha de ensayo, método analítico, firma y documento quedan accesibles desde la ficha del lote.
